{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes, showing 1-3 euro lag/undershoot throughout the 30-day horizon",
    "The forecast bias increases in later forecast horizons, with differences growing from ~0.3-0.5 on day 1-10 to ~1.0-2.0 on day 20-30",
    "When current price is below history mean, model remains biased below true prices; when above mean, bias narrows but doesn't fully eliminate",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.5) provides modest lift to true outcomes but model doesn't fully capture the magnitude, especially in longer horizons",
    "Model fails to anticipate the gradual downward trajectory in true outcomes - it under-forecasts the decline by 0.5-1.0 each day after day 10",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes isn't random but shows clear mean-reversion pattern, converging from ~0.5 initial difference to ~1.0+ by day 30"
] }
